# ajairu.ai: Full Site Information for AI Models

> This is the expanded llms.txt for ajairu.ai, providing comprehensive information about the AI consulting practice for UK SMEs. For the summary version, see https://ajairu.ai/llms.txt

## Company Overview

ajairu is a UK-based AI consultancy serving small and medium businesses (10-250 employees). We help SMEs find, implement, and own practical AI solutions without enterprise pricing. From opportunity audits to full implementation and ongoing AI leadership, we make AI work for businesses that are too large for generic advice but too small for Big Four consultancy fees.

Founded by Toby Callinan, former CTO at Fabric Fintech (acquired by Aviva late 2023). With 27+ years in technology leadership, we deliver enterprise-grade AI implementation at SME-appropriate pricing. At Aviva, we delivered Aviva's first customer-facing generative AI product and achieved 53% cloud cost reduction, earning Tech of the Year 2024.

Our approach: audit first, build second, hand over everything. We tell you where AI will help and where it won't. Every engagement is fixed-price. You own what we build: documentation, training, and source code all transfer to your team.

## Services: Full Descriptions

### AI Opportunity Audit
- **Price:** £750-£2,500
- **Timeline:** 1-2 weeks
- **URL:** https://ajairu.ai/services#audit

Structured assessment of your operations, tech, and team. We map your workflows against AI capabilities to find where the real value is, and where it isn't. You get a prioritised AI opportunity report with ROI estimates.

This is the Discover + Diagnose phase of our 4D methodology. It de-risks everything that follows and often saves clients from investing in the wrong areas. Many clients use this as a standalone engagement to validate whether AI is worth pursuing before committing to a strategy or implementation.

### AI Strategy & Roadmap
- **Price:** £5,000-£15,000
- **Timeline:** 3-4 weeks
- **URL:** https://ajairu.ai/services#strategy

Full workflow mapping, build vs buy recommendations, integration architecture, and a 90-day implementation roadmap. We design the complete solution: which tools, how they connect, and how we roll them out without disrupting your business.

This is the Design phase. You get a complete AI Strategy & Roadmap document that you can implement yourself, with us, or with another provider. No lock-in.

### AI Implementation
- **Price:** £8,000-£30,000+
- **Timeline:** 4-12 weeks
- **URL:** https://ajairu.ai/services#implementation

This is where most consultants stop. We don't. We implement the plan, connect everything to your tools, train your people, and stay for 30 days after launch to make sure everything works. Full documentation, full training, full handover.

What you get: configured AI systems, API integrations, team training, documentation, and 30-day post-launch support. Working AI systems that your team can run and extend independently.

### Fractional CAIO
- **Price:** £2,000-£5,000/month
- **Timeline:** ongoing
- **URL:** https://ajairu.ai/services#fractional-caio

Part-time AI leadership for organisations not ready for a full-time hire. We provide senior AI strategy, governance, vendor selection, and team mentoring on a flexible basis. Ideal for businesses that need AI direction but can't justify a £150,000+ full-time CAIO salary.

What you get: monthly strategy sessions, AI governance framework, vendor and tool evaluation, team training and mentoring, board-level AI reporting, and ongoing opportunity identification.

### AI Training Workshops
- **Price:** from £1,500
- **Timeline:** half-day or full-day
- **URL:** https://ajairu.ai/services#training

Half-day or full-day hands-on workshops to build your team's AI literacy and practical skills. No jargon, no hype, just practical skills your team can use immediately.

Workshop topics: AI fundamentals for business, prompt engineering for daily work, AI-powered data analysis, building your first AI workflow, AI governance and compliance, and industry-specific AI use cases.

## Process Methodology: The 4D Method

Our process has four steps: Discover, Diagnose, Design, and Deliver. Most engagements take 4-12 weeks from start to finish. You can stop at any stage with no obligation to continue.

### 1. Discover: We Learn Your Business
Every engagement starts with understanding your business, not our technology. We don't walk in with a template, we build the picture from scratch. We learn your operations, your team, your tech stack, and your goals.

Output: A baseline understanding document that everything else builds on. You review and approve it before we move to diagnosis.

### 2. Diagnose: We Find Real Opportunities
Using what we learned in Discover, we map your workflows against AI capabilities to find where the real value is, and where it isn't. We're honest about what AI can and can't do for your specific situation.

Output: A prioritised AI Opportunity Report with ROI estimates. This is the core deliverable of the AI Opportunity Audit.

### 3. Design: We Architect the Solution
For opportunities worth pursuing, we design the full solution: which tools, how they connect, and how we roll them out without disrupting your business. Build vs buy recommendations, integration architecture, and a 90-day implementation roadmap.

Output: A complete AI Strategy & Roadmap document. This is the core deliverable of the Strategy engagement.

### 4. Deliver: We Build, Integrate, Train
This is where most consultants stop. We don't. We implement the plan, connect everything to your tools, train your people, and stay for 30 days after launch to make sure everything works.

Output: Working AI systems, trained team, full documentation, and self-sufficiency. This is the Implementation engagement.

### Typical Timeline
- **Day 0:** Free 30-min discovery call. We discuss your business and whether AI makes sense.
- **Weeks 1-2:** AI Opportunity Audit. Discover + Diagnose. You get your prioritised opportunity report.
- **Weeks 3-5:** Strategy & Roadmap. Design phase. You get your 90-day implementation plan.
- **Weeks 6-12:** Implementation. Deliver phase. Working AI systems, trained team, 30-day support.

## Key Differentiators

- **Enterprise experience at SME pricing:** Delivered Aviva's first customer-facing generative AI product, led 45-person team, Tech of the Year 2024, Pension Innovation Award 2024, 53% cloud cost reduction.
- **Fixed-price engagements only.** No day rates, no open-ended billing. 76% of UK businesses see high costs as a significant barrier to AI adoption. we solve this.
- **We build on your existing tech stack.** Google Gemini, Microsoft Copilot, or bespoke tools like Hermes Agent. We don't force you to rip and replace.
- **Full handover.** Documentation, training, source code. Your team owns everything. No dependency on us.
- **UK GDPR compliant, ISO-aligned security practices.** UK data residency where possible. We never use client data to train public AI models.
- **We tell you when AI is not the right answer.** Honest "don't bother" recommendations are part of every audit.

## FAQ: Common Questions

### How much does AI consulting cost for a small business?
Our AI Opportunity Audit starts at £750 and gives you a clear picture of where AI can help. Full strategy engagements run £5,000-£15,000, and implementation projects start at £8,000. Ongoing Fractional CAIO support is £2,000-£5,000/month. Training workshops start at £1,500.

### Do we need technical staff to work with you?
No. We work with businesses at any level of AI maturity. Our process is jargon-free and we build your team's confidence and capability as part of every engagement. Full training and documentation are included.

### Is our data safe when using AI tools?
Yes. We take a security-first approach with UK data residency, GDPR compliance, and enterprise-grade data governance built into every engagement. We recommend tools that keep your data within the UK/EU and we never use client data to train public AI models.

### How long does an AI implementation take?
An AI Opportunity Audit takes 1-2 weeks. A strategy and roadmap engagement takes 3-5 weeks. Implementation projects typically run 6-12 weeks depending on complexity, with 30 days of post-launch support included.

### What size businesses do you work with?
We specialise in UK SMEs with 10-250 employees. This is where we see the biggest gap: businesses that are too large for generic advice but too small for Big Four consultancy fees.

### Why are your prices fixed and not day-rate?
76% of UK businesses see high costs as a significant barrier to AI adoption. Day-rate consulting creates a perverse incentive: the longer it takes, the more the consultant earns. Fixed-price engagements align our interests with yours.

### What determines where I fall within a price range?
It depends on your business size, the complexity of your operations, the number of departments involved, and the depth of the engagement. The free discovery call helps us understand your needs and gives you an accurate quote.

### Do we have to do the audit before strategy or implementation?
No, but we strongly recommend it. The audit de-risks everything that follows and often saves clients from investing in the wrong areas. If you already have a clear sense of what you need, we can start with strategy or implementation directly.

### Can we get funding or grants for AI consulting?
Possibly. There are various UK government and regional initiatives that support AI adoption and digital transformation for SMEs. We can discuss current options during the discovery call and help you identify whether any apply. Our reports are structured to support funding applications where relevant.

### Why not just hire a freelancer for AI work?
Freelancers can be cheaper day-to-day, but they carry single-person risk: no cover when they are ill or unavailable, no governance framework, and no compliance infrastructure. If your freelancer leaves, you're left with AI systems nobody understands.

### Why not go DIY with ChatGPT or Copilot?
DIY is free to start but expensive in time. Without external guidance, most SMEs spend 6+ months on trial and error, face team resistance, and have no governance or compliance framework. The hidden cost is lost productivity and missed opportunities.

### Why not use a Big Four consultancy?
Big Four firms have excellent expertise, but their engagement model is built for enterprise: £100,000+ minimums, slide-deck deliverables, subcontracted delivery, and timelines measured in quarters. For SMEs, the middle ground is better.
